Apply the available RFQ template so the pricing sheet is created.
Add the requested product and enter the large quantity value.
Verify the first line item's quantity remains the requested large value.
Set the requested delivery location if the sheet exposes it as a selectable field.
Add one available QA vendor participant.
Publish the completed RFQ as required by the scenario.
Verify publishing reached a real project page.
